antworten: A big computer on the internet that runs the language model
A small program that offers an agent tools
A virus scanner for the Agent PC
fragen.erklaerung: An MCP server offers tools (e.g. “rotate page”). Hermes chooses the right tool and uses it.

fragen.frage: Why does an MCP server only get one particular folder?
antworten: So the agent can only read and change files there
fragen.erklaerung: What the agent can't reach, it can't accidentally change or delete either.
